test_title: PYST 8: SSC CPO - English (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT a cause of the spread of false information on social media?

options.text: Lack of education and critical thinking skills among social media users.
Inability to discern between credible sources and fake news.
Social media companies’ failure to regulate false information on their platforms.
The desire of people to engage in controversial and sensational content.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The question which is **NOT a cause of the spread of false information on social media.**
 
• The **passage does not explicitly mention the desire of people to engage in controversial and sensational content **as a cause of the spread of false information on social media.
 
• It does, however, directly address:
 
 
• The **role of education and critical thinking skills**, suggesting their lack as a contributing factor to the spread of misinformation (implied in the solution of educating people on how to think critically and fact-check).
 
• The** difficulty in discerning between credible and fake sources** as part of the problem.
 
• The **need for social media companies to regulate false information** on their platforms.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"The desire of people to engage in controversial and sensational content" **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option (1) **Lack of education and critical thinking skills among social media users: **The passage implies this as part of the solution to combat misinformation, stressing the importance of teaching people how to think critically and fact-check (last paragraph).
 
• Option (2)** Inability to discern between credible sources and fake news: **Mentioned as a challenge that needs to be addressed through education (last paragraph).
 
• Option (3) **Social media companies’ failure to regulate false information on their platforms:** While the passage does not explicitly state this as a cause, it suggests holding social media companies accountable and ensuring they combat misinformation (last paragraph), indirectly implying their role in the spread when they do not regulate effectively.
